what_happened: Both measurement instruments the cost baseline needs already exist with no new dependency: Mathlib's #count_heartbeats in <cmd> (Mathlib/Util/CountHeartbeats.lean, present in the pinned v4.33.0-rc1 tree) and Lean.Expr.sizeWithoutSharing. Five lean_run_code probes produced the whole baseline inside research, including an exact closed form for lintro nesting cost (5n^2+17n+41, fitting n=2..16 with zero residual).
